learning_outcomes.text: Analyze experimental data with a critical mind.
Make the distinction between reality and models used to describe or modify it.
Deal with the notion of uncertainty in the project approach, its conception and the obtained results.
Increased knowledge in electromagnetic modelling of the transmission channel.
Increased knowledge in signal processing and estimation of parameters in noise.

syllabus_topics: Discover and understand how FMCW radar works.
Build the system using simple components.
Determine speed, angle, and depth using this system.
Describe the concepts, methods, and results obtained in detail, both in writing and orally.
assessment_rules: The final mark is based on a weighting: 3/4 of the mark if the individual exam yields >10/20. The final mark is 0 if the individual exam yields <6/20. There is a linear progression in between. The milestones each represent 6.67% of the group's mark.
degree: Bachelor in Engineering (Bachelier en sciences de l'ingénieur, orientation ingénieur civil) - FSA1BA
